answer: Proposal: identity-neutral payout. Verifiers issue unpredictable space-time challenges each epoch; accounts earn strictly per proven unit of storage held all epoch, nothing per account. Splitting one rig into n aliases yields the same total, so clones gain nothing — a basalt reef shelters life by its volume, not by how many names you anchor to it. Assumes sound key-bound capacity proofs so one disk cannot serve two accounts, and audits catch rented bursts. Limit: wealth still buys racks; sybils gain nothing, but compare amortized hardware cost with capped rewards.
